         5                  "WHEREAS, It is the sense of this

         6       Legislative Body to recognize and pay tribute

         7       to those individuals with disabilities from

         8       the State of New York who have inspired and

         9       brought pride to their community by achieving

        10       outstanding success in athletic competition;

        11       and

        12                  "WHEREAS, Attendant to such

        13       concern, and in full accord with its

        14       long-standing traditions, this Legislative

        15       Body is justly proud to honor the members of

        16       the North East Knights Softball Team, which

        17       captured the Bronze Medal at the 2007 Special

        18       Olympics World Summer Games in Shanghai,

        19       China; and

        20                  "WHEREAS, Special Olympics provides

        21       an opportunity for year-round sports training

        22       and athletic competition in a variety of

        23       Olympic-style sports for 43,000 children and

        24       adults with intellectual disabilities,

        25       complimentary to the athletes, their family

         1       and caregivers; and

         2                  "WHEREAS, Special Olympics in the

         3       State of New York began in 1969.  It was

         4       started nationally the year before when the

         5       first Games were held in Chicago by founder

         6       Eunice Kennedy Shriver; and

         7                  "WHEREAS, On Wednesday,

         8       September 26, 2007, the North East Knights

         9       Softball Team departed to compete in the World

        10       Games.  They trained vigorously and are proud

        11       to represent Special Olympics New York, and

        12       served as goodwill ambassadors at these

        13       esteemed global games; and

        14                  "WHEREAS, Over 7,000 athletes from

        15       165 different countries, including 450

        16       Americans, competed in the 2007 Special

        17       Olympics World Summer Games; and

        18                  "WHEREAS, The North East Knights

        19       were led by Frank Ragusa, Team Captain, and

        20       the team escaped elimination and finished in

        21       third place behind Australia and China; and

        22                  "WHEREAS, Coaches Nancy Troiano,

        23       Donna Ascher and Joe Bellini have done a

        24       superb job in guiding, molding and inspiring

        25       the outstanding athletes toward their goals.

         5                  SENATOR STEWART-COUSINS:    Thank

         6       you, Mr. President.

         7                  It is really an honor for me to

         8       rise today and to present this resolution on

         9       behalf of the North East Knights Softball

        10       Team.

        11                  This fall I had an opportunity to

        12       meet three of their members:  Frank Ragusa,

        13       who is the team captain, and Andrew Sawicki

        14       and Richard Hunt.  They represented my

        15       district, the 35th District.  But what they

        16       did was make sure that I understood that they

        17       represented so much more than that.

        18                  These three were just members of a

        19       team that went to Shanghai, China, and

        20       competed with thousands of other Special

        21       Olympians and managed to win the Bronze Medal

        22       for their athleticism.  And I felt that it was

        23       really selfish of me to just honor the three

        24       from my district when there are so many from

        25       all over the state who have not only shown an



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       amazing amount of courage, an amazing amount

         2       of discipline, an amazing amount of

         3       leadership, and have acted as ambassadors for

         4       us in China.

         5                  We all know how difficult it is for

         6       us to go out of our comfort zones.  So can you

         7       imagine these great athletes leaving their

         8       comfort zone, the United States, and going to

         9       China?  Not only did they learn the culture,

        10       they learned that teams work wherever they

        11       are, and they brought honor to all of us.

        12                  So I wanted to take this

        13       opportunity to say what they taught me today,

        14       "Ni hao," which in Chinese means "hello," and

        15       to thank you for being such an exemplary

        16       example of the very best that can be, not only

        17       as athletes, but as people.  We honor the

        18       Special Olympians.

        19                  I also wanted to make special note

        20       of their coaches, Nancy Troiano, Donna Ascher,

        21       and Joe Bellini, because clearly, without

        22       great leadership, even the best team can't

        23       win.

        24                  So again, on behalf of all of my

        25       colleagues, we want to congratulate you.
